# Pattern Decoder

> A free guide to 335 manipulation and control tactics in plain words: what each one looks like, how to tell if it fits, and what you can do. It is a reading aid, not a diagnosis, a legal opinion or therapy. By Noble Father Creations.

## Start here

- [Every tactic, grouped by line](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/tactics): all 335 tactics, each linked to its own page
- [Pattern Decoder, the interactive guide](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook): search by what was said or done, or answer two short questions
- [Use this guide safely](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook#/safety): what applies to every entry, and how to leave quickly

- [Patterns](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/patterns): Gaslighting, DARVO, FOG and other famous names, each broken into the single tactics it is made of

## The ten lines

- [Turning people against you](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-people): Isolating you, using other people, and controlling who hears what.
- [Twisting what is real](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-truth): Lies, denial and confusion that leave you unsure of your own memory or judgment.
- [Dodging blame](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-blame): Ways a person avoids responsibility, or turns it back on you.
- [Work, school and systems](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-systems): When an organization, its rules or its paperwork become the weapon.
- [Control over your life](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-control): Rules, monitoring and limits on your time, money, body or choices.
- [Guilt, pressure and fear](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-pressure): Pushing you to say yes through guilt, obligation, urgency or threat.
- [Love that hooks you](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-hook): Affection, attention and promises used to pull you in and keep you there.
- [Put-downs that wear you down](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-wear): Insults, contempt and slow erosion of how you see yourself.
- [Groups, cults and propaganda](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-society): Influence over whole groups: high-control groups, propaganda and influence operations.
- [Online and technology](https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/line-online): Fake accounts, deepfakes, tracking, scams and pressure through screens.

## Notes for assistants

- Each tactic has its own page at https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/<name> with what it is, signs it fits and signs it does not, what you can do, and look-alikes.
- Where an entry can involve danger, its page opens with a safety note. Please keep that note with the answer.
- Nothing a reader types is sent anywhere. Sitemap: https://noblefathercreations.com/playbook/sitemap.xml
